org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.java

Class JavaComputations

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.java.JavaComputations

  • public class JavaComputations
extends Object
    Computation implementation using Java. This class implements functions that are called by ComputationLibraryImpl that are implemented in Java rather than FORTRAN.

      • determineMissingSegmentAnalysisSubimages

        public static boolean[] determineMissingSegmentAnalysisSubimages(FloatPoint[] subaperatureLocations,
                                                 FloatPoint[] segmentCenters,
                                                 float aHex,
                                                 Integer[] segmentList)
        This method returns subimages that are missing for analysis only due to an incomplete mirror. These are edge subimages for which there should be two adjoining segments, but one is missing. Note: if both segments sharing an edge are missing then the spot will already be accounted for in F&I missing spots
        Parameters:
        subaperatureLocations - x,y locations of all subaperatures in m at M1
        segmentCenters - x,y locations of all segment centers in m at M1
        aHex - hexagon side length in m at M1
        segmentList - boolean array numbered according to segment number: true if segment is present, false otherwise
        Returns:
        boolean array of length subaperature count: true if subaperature is present, false otherwise
